correctness.rationale: Zero-sum quadratic form exactly splits into two strictly negative peripheral contrasts, -W w² and a (u,z) block whose upper-left=-2 t^p and determinant=2Z; thus both inequalities are necessary and sufficient. T(p)=double integral p(p-1)(t+r+s)^(p-2) strictly increases on p in[1,2] for t>=1; W has one zero from 3/2 to -1/2. Exact outward rational-power integer enclosures from source verify t=1,p=47/25: W<0,Z>0 and t=10,p=48/25:W>0,Z<0. Concavity of Z_1 as a function of 2^p proves it positive up to 47/25; at t=10 negative type interval heredity forces Z first. Continuity of H(t)=Z_t(p_W(t)) gives joint critical zero. Exactly two null directions in the five-dimensional zero-sum space yield rank three; strict downward p-negative type ensures rank five below. Independent full-distance quadratic check for 3 t, two integer p and 3^5 coefficient profiles plus separate high-precision sign corroboration.
